data.standardized_narrative: Unable to extract reliable detailed reserve movement information from the provided scanned images. The report appears to be denominated in GBP and contains technical provisions and claims development tables, but the scanned images are not legible enough to confidently read the gross claims outstanding opening balance or the explicit prior year reserve movement (gross).
data.data_quality_notes: The provided PDF pages are scanned images with low legibility in this interface. Key numeric lines (Gross claims outstanding at 1-Jan-2019, Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding) could not be confidently read. A visible figure of total gross premiums written of approximately 523,224 (reported in thousands) was identified but not fully verifiable; other requested items (gross opening reserves, gross prior-year development, claims triangle) could not be extracted with confidence. Recommend providing higher-resolution OCR-capable PDF or the original digital report for precise extraction. Where numeric items are essential, I returned null rather than risk misreporting.
